Celtic have eye on midfielder Ebonog - gossip
- Published
Two possible January targets for Celtic as Turkish club maintain interest in Rangers midfielder...
Celtic are monitoring Le Havre midfielder Simon Ebonog ahead of the January transfer window, with Sevilla also linked with the 22-year-old. (Celts Are Here, external)
Celtic could return for summer target Gvidas Gineitis, with Torino lowering their valuation of the Lithuania midfielder. (TuttoMercato via Daily Record, external)
Having failed to land Nico Raskin in the summer, Besiktas scouts kept a close eye on the Rangers midfielder when he played for Belgium in Turkey this week. (Kartal Haber via Scottish Sun, external)
Rangers are planning to trigger their buy option for James Penrice as soon as possible as the left-back impresses on loan from AEK Athens. (Football Insider, external)
Falkirk want John McGlynn, 64, to be their manager for the rest of his career, says the club's chief executive Jamie Swinney. (Daily Record, subscription required, external)
Falkirk face the prospect of playing next season's Premier Sports Cup group stage home matches at a neutral venue as the club push on with plans to replace their artificial surface with a grass pitch. (Falkirk Herald, external)
St Johnstone chairman Adam Webb reveals most of the club's budget was spent in the summer but says he will go the extra mile to help manager Simo Valakari top up his squad in January, if required. (The Courier, external)
Former Scotland midfielder John Collins has urged Sebastien Pocognoli to ditch his 3-4-1-2 system and unleash Ben Gannon-Doak in a more attacking role in a 4-3-3 set-up. (The Herald, subscription required, external)
